label: VERIFIED
extraction: Laya: Open-source, local-first AI notification command center for Slack, Gmail, GitHub, Jira, and 9 connected platforms. Three scope toggles gate client capabilities: Read, Write, Egress. Bearer-token auth or loopback-only mode. Full surface: search cards, semantic search, mutate, trigger outbound actions. Same transport powers Laya's in-app coding agents — one path, one policy. Local-first architecture keeps data on user's machine.
